TaxoArena Test Ledger

Every experiment of the publication campaign: its condition, registration, status, and result, with the evidence pointer (commit or artifact in the repo). Updated as results land.

Sections: (1) the headline claims the paper rests on, each pointing at its ledger id; (2) construction & geometry; (3) arena & matchmaking; (4) the judge program, with the rubric-value history as one row; (5) the Phase-0 bias audit; (6) incidents & hygiene; (7) what is running now with its registered criteria; (8) queued, designed and deprioritized items. Within a section rows run in adjudication order.

v430 · 2026-09-14 · legend: REGISTERED = criteria frozen & committed before launch · EXPLORATORY = post-hoc, disclosed, adjudicates nothing · chips: PASS / FAIL / NULL / WITHDRAWN / VOID / RUNNING / QUEUED / DESCRIPTIVE / INCIDENT
*permutation p-values are quoted at their floor 1/(B+1), B=1,000: "0.001" means at or below the smallest attainable value, not a point estimate.

THE p2dca JUDGED FAMILY IS HISTORY, NOT EVIDENCE. MEMBERSHIP. A readout is in the family if any of three things holds. (a) It contains a judge verdict, or a reference or judge solve scored against the key, produced on matches drawn from pool p2dca21ab5f4ef3ae as the held-out side of the split of record. The judge, recipe, prompt, schedule, language and date do not matter. The r8-era runs (x8, x12 v1, R2, the rubric line, the J-series) are in, and so is the post-incident STACK-v2 work (R3, ARENA-V2 x12 and x20, ARENA-13, GROK-CALIB, the Kotlin board, the v1 canary, placement). (b) It is computed on the schedule or judged-question set of such a run in order to bound, compare with or fit a judged number (e.g. ORACLE-BOARD, KEY-NOISE-CEILING). (c) It imports a quantity from (a) or (b) into its criterion, scale, comparator or simulation parameters. The bracket then attaches to that quantity only (e.g. K46's nu / beta scale; BFCL-JUDGED-PILOT's NONE and CACHED_SOLVE rungs). Membership follows the run's split. It does not follow the question's id or a printed pool id. A verdict produced under another split, on a question that is also in p2dca, is not a family verdict (K46's ONE class, split pv2_41dbd3dbcd399df0). CERT-CORPUS prints p2dca but reads GEN-ARENA's union re-derivation, so it is not in the family either. Key-only readouts on p2dca are NOT in the family. They carry rule 12's "id-disjoint only" and, where tree-filed, "filed by a qwen3 tree". Frozen-tree geometry is governed by the r8 paragraph and its geometry-only carve-out. WHY. Every member is on an id-only split: 37 exact / 70 norm-v1 EVAL texts sit among bareq512_s42's members. The family's central objects carry further defects: - The x12 schedule, and every board and sample drawn from it (R3; ARENA-V2 x12 / x20; GROK-CALIB; the Kotlin board), was cut on the 87 cells of the frozen tree 20260727_042523. That tree's routing was in-sample for 2,437 of the 3,445 judgeable questions. - The r8-era cell rubrics were induced on corpora that held those questions with the answer ticked. The STACK-v2 anchor rubrics withheld p2dca by id only, with 28 twins in their induction corpora. - The recipe of record was selected on R3's 944 key-decidable pairs with no family-wise control; 0.865 is that sample's maximum (FW L79). - Every family board is among the 51 of 58 caches that cannot tell NON_TERMINATED from wrong (JUDGE-FINISH-AUDIT). The directions of these biases are unsigned. Content-closed replacements are registered or drafted (RP04, RP19, RP20, RP21). USE. A family number is written in only four ways: (1) DISCLOSURE, in the one first-iteration paragraph. (2) DESIGN PROVENANCE, in the voice of a decision ("the recipe was fixed, and the lines of CTX §5 closed, on the first-iteration sample"), never in the voice of a finding. (3) A PLANNING PRIOR inside a registration (Support, prediction, power, threshold). A content-closed outcome may withdraw it and may never promote it. (4) An ENGINEERING FIXTURE for byte-identity and regression tests of code. It is never a clause of the claim table, an abstract or results sentence, a licence, a thesis board, or a deciding comparator of a new criterion ("within delta of" or "above" a family number). No content-closed number is written as confirming, replicating or "consistent with" one. Methods, estimators, rules and guards developed on family data carry no bracket; their family-fitted parameters do. The record's refusals stand without the family. The lines closed in CTX §5 stay closed, and this bracket is not a reason to reopen them. A later bracket on a family row may change the row's number or words, but not its membership. Only a bracket naming this ruling can change the class.]] [CORRECTED 2026-09-27 by the registrar (INCONSISTENCIES-PASS RP01 C2; docs/judge_v2_program.md L80, the SPLIT-FOLLOWUPS review 8ebfa7a bracket, _as_of 5effe96): the WHY clause "The STACK-v2 anchor rubrics withheld p2dca by id only, with 28 twins in their induction corpora" (and the ruling's section 2 D3 "STACK-v2's anchor rubric is bareq512_s42's") names the WRONG OBJECT. 1 · Headline claims

Scope, and the first thing a reviewer will ask (ledger audit, 2026-09-14). "Judge accuracy" throughout this record means AGREEMENT WITH AN ANSWER KEY — MMLU-Pro's, or a corpus-specific one. There is no human annotation, no inter-annotator agreement and no preference data anywhere in this campaign. What was measured is verification fidelity: whether a judge can tell which of two responses is CORRECT. It is not preference fidelity: whether a judge agrees with people about which response is BETTER. That is a deliberate scope choice — it is what makes every result here checkable against ground truth — and it should be stated in the abstract rather than left for a reader to discover. It also bounds the generalisation: nothing here speaks to open-ended generation, where no key exists and preference is the only criterion. See also docs/RESULTS.md, which reports the thesis proper on a different roster and does not share these numbers.

Registered power assumed a 0.10 discordant rate; the observed 0.02 means it could not have detected 6pp as a significance test — but the low discordance IS the measurement.
